name: xTiles
description: xTiles turns your conversations into organized, visual projects. Instead of losing research, plans, or ideas in scattered chat threads, ask Claude to structure them directly into pages, tasks, and layouts inside your xTiles workspace. Turn a brainstorm into a project board, a trip idea into a planning page, or messy notes into something clear you can revisit, edit, and share. Claude can also pull your existing pages, projects, and tasks back into the chat, so you can review and update what's already there — all without leaving the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add xTiles to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add xTiles to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.xtiles.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the xTiles MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: xTiles lists 28 MCP tools, including xtiles_create_project_from_markdown, xtiles_create_tasks, xtiles_create_tiles_from_markdown_by_view, xtiles_create_tiles_from_markdown_in_my_planner, xtiles_create_tiles_from_markdown_in_project_planner, xtiles_create_tiles_from_markdown_in_view, xtiles_create_view_from_markdown, xtiles_delete_tasks, xtiles_get_collection_content, xtiles_get_current_user, xtiles_get_page_layout, and xtiles_get_planner_content.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to xTiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to xTiles in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
xTiles requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
xTiles is developed by XTILES INC.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
